notes.title: Improvements to base
notes.content:
Made several improvements to the base in the beginning of the game:
[list]
[*] Better textures
[*] Interesting transitions between levels
[*] Improved effects, such as explosions and sparks
[/list]

Also improved the launchpad area with a more interesting landscape, better colors and changing the lighting to nighttime.
